name: smarthire-local
description: Local-first recruitment platform with AI-powered candidate ranking

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && PORT=3001 npm run dev
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "cd backend && PORT=3001 node server.js" "cd frontend && tail -f /dev/null | npx next dev -p 5000"
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
